sentences.quote: Sandeep Bakhshi (born 28 May 1960) is an Indian banker, and the MD & CEO, ICICI Bank since October 2018.
sentences.text: Sandeep Bakhshi, born in 1960, is an Indian banker who has served as Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of ICICI Bank since October 2018; he holds a mechanical engineering degree from Punjab Engineering College in Chandigarh and a postgraduate management qualification from XLRI - Xavier School of Management, Jamshedpur.

sentences.quote: Bakhshi, an employee of ICICI since 1986, was appointed as MD & CEO in October 2018.[3][4][5] Prior to this, he was the managing director and CEO of ICICI Prudential Life Insurance from August 2010 to June 2018
sentences.text: He joined the ICICI group in 1986 and, before becoming bank CEO, led ICICI Prudential Life Insurance from August 2010 to June 2018 and headed ICICI Lombard General Insurance from 2002.

He was appointed a wholetime director and Chief Operating Officer designate effective July 31, 2018, before the board named him MD and CEO on October 4, 2018, succeeding Chanda Kochhar, who stepped down amid a conflict-of-interest inquiry.

mgmt_bio.text: Sandeep Bakhshi, born in 1960, is an Indian banker who has served as Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of ICICI Bank since October 2018; he holds a mechanical engineering degree from Punjab Engineering College in Chandigarh and a postgraduate management qualification from XLRI - Xavier School of Management, Jamshedpur. He joined the ICICI group in 1986 and, before becoming bank CEO, led ICICI Prudential Life Insurance from August 2010 to June 2018 and headed ICICI Lombard General Insurance from 2002. The Reserve Bank of India approved his reappointment for a further two years from October 4, 2026 to October 3, 2028.

sentences.quote: Total loan portfolio grew by 19.6% year-on-year to  16,31,260 crore (US$ 172.3 billion) at June 30, 2026
sentences.text: ICICI Bank Ltd continues to compound loan growth, with its total loan portfolio up 19.6% year-on-year to about 16,31,260 crore rupees at June 30, 2026.
Margins have held up, with net interest margin at 4.36% in Q1-2027 against 4.32% in Q4-2026 and 4.34% a year earlier, supported by an average CASA ratio of 38.1%.

Asset quality is benign, with the gross NPA ratio at 1.38% and net NPA at 0.35% in Q1FY27, and provisions of 12.60 billion rupees, or 0.32% of average advances, down from 18.15 billion a year earlier.

sentences.quote: The Bank's total capital adequacy ratio at June 30, 2026 was 16.84% and CET-1 ratio was 16.19% compared to the minimum regulatory requirements of 11.70% and 8.20% respectively.
sentences.text: Capital is ample, with a total capital adequacy ratio of 16.84% and CET-1 of 16.19% versus minimum requirements of 11.70% and 8.20%.
